Source-protection check, 2026-10-25

Sensitive local configuration files were found only in ignored locations:
* backend/backend/.env is ignored by backend/.gitignore.
* website/.env.development is ignored by website/.gitignore.
* app/.env.local.json is ignored by app/.gitignore.

The Flutter source ignore rules were extended to exclude /artifacts/ and *.hprof.
This prevents generated APKs, visual QA captures, and a Java heap dump from entering a source baseline.

The dashboard has an existing remote. The backend, website and app currently have local Git repositories but no committed remote baseline; no source was pushed or published during this work. The owner must establish reviewed private remotes and make the initial commits after reviewing the project assets.
